purpose: Actual source-checkpoint detector proposals from saved pixels; no precise localization or production rollout

model.backend: PyTorch CPU development-host reference; not compiled Coral numerical parity

manual_crop_comparison.method: highest-IoU greedy; not physical identity or detection ground truth

temporal_replay.frame_selection: Sequential decode, exact nearest source frame at n / sample_hz; no interpolation
temporal_replay.association_method: Greedy same-class nearest source-center, no prediction, no semantic identity
temporal_replay.limitation: Touching rack balls may merge or swap IDs. No physical truth, stationarity label, tracking accuracy, real-time availability or target latency is established.

limitations: Manual crop boxes are neither detector truth nor physical center labels.
Saved videos were used for INT8 calibration; this is not independent heldout detector validation.
PyTorch source-model proposals may differ from Coral conversion, quantization and deployment preprocessing.
Source-box midpoint preserves detector geometry; it is not a validated physical ball center.
